claim: Interpretability as a Science is scoped to rigor/falsifiability standards for LLM interpretability claims specifically, not to architecture search or design-agent evaluation, and its own fetched CFP page omits page limit, anonymity policy, archival status, and submission mechanics entirely.
stance_target: Whether Interpretability as a Science is a viable venue candidate for the target paper
scope_conditions: Interpretability as a Science workshop homepage as fetched Aug 2026
quoted_support: This workshop asks what it would take to ground interpretability as a rigorous empirical science—drawing lessons from disciplines that have long studied complex systems.
